get.summary: Find Nearest Destination and Compare Routes
get.description: Calculates routes from a single origin to multiple destinations, returning travel times, distances, and paths. Helps determine which destination is nearest in terms of actual travel cost.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: A single origin coordinate pair in the format `{lat,lon}`. Example: `{8.457685259188599,38.764792722654455}`

parameters.name: json
parameters.description: An array of destination coordinate pairs in the format `[{lat1,lon1},{lat2,lon2},...]`.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: API key used for authentication and usage control.

200.description: Travel time and distance from the origin to each destination.

origins.description: The origins, snapped to the nearest road.

destinations.description: The destinations, snapped to the nearest road.

origin_to_destination.description: One entry per origin and destination pair.

from.description: Position of the origin in the list you sent.

to.description: Position of the destination in the list you sent.

get.description: Calculates a matrix of travel times and distances between multiple geographic points. This is useful for logistics, delivery optimization, or any application requiring pairwise route calculations between several origins and destinations.

parameters.name: json
parameters.description: A list of coordinate pairs in the format `[{lat1,lon1},{lat2,lon2},...]`. These coordinates are used as both origins and destinations to compute the matrix.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: API key used for authentication and access control.

200.description: Travel time and distance between every pair of points.

origins.description: The origins, snapped to the nearest road.

destinations.description: The destinations, snapped to the nearest road.

origin_to_destination.description: One entry per origin and destination pair.

from.description: Position of the origin in the list you sent.

to.description: Position of the destination in the list you sent.

post.summary: Get Optimized Delivery Routes for Multiple Drivers
post.description: Calculates the most efficient delivery routes for multiple drivers based on depot, customer locations, and vehicle capacities. Useful for logistics, courier services, or any multi-stop delivery scenario.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: Your API key to authorize the request

vehicles.description: List of available drivers/vehicles with their current locations and capacity limits

current_location.description: Current location of the driver [longitude, latitude]

capacities.description: How many boxes the vehicle can carry.

customers.description: List of customer locations with delivery demand

requested_from_depot.description: Name of the depot the customer expects the delivery from

depots.description: List of depot locations where deliveries originate

200.description: Returns optimized routes with assigned customers and their respective depots for each driver

routes.description: List of optimized delivery routes for each driver

customers.description: List of customers assigned to this driver

requestedFromDepot.description: Depot from which the delivery was requested

get.description: Solves a Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) using the coordinates provided and returns the most optimal visiting order, original order, route geometry, and total distance and time taken. The route starts and ends at the first coordinate.

parameters.name: json
parameters.description: A JSON-formatted string representing a list of geographic coordinates (longitude, latitude). The first coordinate is considered the start and end point of the round trip. e.g [[8.987685259188599, 38.764792722654455], [8.9879443, 38.7651287], [9.087685259188599, 38.764792722654455]]

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: A valid API key for authentication and access control.

200.description: The best visiting order as a round trip from the first stop.

best_order.description: Stops in visiting order, starting and ending at the first stop. original_index is the position in the list you sent.

original_order.description: Stops in the order you sent them.

total_distance.description: Length of the round trip in kilometers.

time_taken.description: Travel time for the round trip in seconds.

Direction.description: The route as [lat, lng] points. Note the capital D.

get.description: Calculates the best driving route between two points, with optional waypoints, and returns the travel time, total distance and the route as coordinates. With `alternative=t`, other possible routes come back in `alternates`.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Starting point of the route in the format `{latitude,longitude}`.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Ending point of the route in the format `{latitude,longitude}`.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

parameters.name: waypoints
parameters.description: An optional list of intermediate points the route must pass through, formatted as an array of `{latitude,longitude}` pairs.

parameters.name: alternative
parameters.description: Set to `t` to also get other possible routes, in `alternates`.

200.description: The route, and alternatives if requested.

alternates.description: Other possible routes. Only present with alternative=t.

get.description: Older endpoint. Use `GET /v2/search/geocode` instead. Search for a place by name. The endpoint returns a list of matching places with details such as location (latitude and longitude), city, country, and type (e.g., neighborhood, landmark).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the place to search for. Can be a full or partial name (e.g., 'meskel').

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: API key used for authenticating the request.

200.description: Successful response containing a list of matching places.

city.description: City where the place is located.

country.description: Country where the place is located.

get.description: Older endpoint. Use `GET /v2/search/geocode` instead. Retrieves a list of places that match a specified name and are located within a defined geographic bounding box. Useful for limiting results to a specific area on a map.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the place to search for. Can be a full or partial name (e.g., 'edna mall').

parameters.name: bound
parameters.description:
A comma-separated string defining the bounding box coordinates in the format `minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat`. This restricts the search to places within this rectangular area.

Example:
- `38.734,9.015,38.788,9.082` corresponds to a box in Addis Ababa.

Ensure coordinates are in WGS84 format (latitude and longitude).

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: API key required for authenticating the request.

get.description: Older endpoint. Use `GET /v2/search/geocode` instead. Retrieves a list of places that match a specified name and are located within a specified country and city. This endpoint allows clients to filter places using location-based attributes.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the place to search for. This can be a full or partial name (e.g., 'edna mall').

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
A filter string used to narrow down search results based on location. The format must be `country:<countryName>|city:<cityName>`. Both fields are required. Use lowercase values with no spaces. For example:
- `country:ethiopia|city:addisababa`
- `country:ethiopia|city:diredewa`

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: API key for authenticating the request. This must be included in all requests to authorize access to the API.

get.description: Retrieve stored addresses from the Gebeta database that match a specific name and type. This endpoint allows users to query places they own or have registered.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the stored place you are searching for. Can be a full or partial match (e.g., 'welkite').

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of place you are looking for (e.g., 'city', 'neighborhood', 'landmark'). Used to refine the search.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: API key used to authenticate and authorize access to the stored data.

200.description: Successful response containing a list of owned or stored places.

data.description: A list of places matching the query.

Country.description: Country where the place is located.

City.description: City where the place is located.

details.description: Additional details stored for the place, typically in JSON format.

get.description: Older endpoint. Use `GET /v2/search/reverse-geocoding` instead. Retrieve place information based on latitude and longitude coordinates. This endpoint returns details such as place name, location, country, city, and type.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude coordinate in decimal degrees (e.g., 9.02152).

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude coordinate in decimal degrees (e.g., 38.80131).

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: API key for authenticating the request.

200.description: Successful response containing place information for the given coordinates.

data.description: List of places corresponding to the provided coordinates.

Country.description: Country where the place is located.

City.description: City where the place is located.

type.description: Type of the place (e.g., neighborhood, landmark).

get.description: Performs reverse geocoding to retrieve nearby locations owned or managed by the service provider, based on geographic coordinates. Supports filtering by place type and level of detail.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the location to reverse geocode.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude of the location to reverse geocode.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: API key used for authenticating requests.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of place to retrieve (e.g., 'terminal', 'warehouse', 'office').

parameters.name: detailLevel
parameters.description: Level of detail for the response. Higher values may include more granular information.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of nearby locations to return.

get.description: Search for a place by name or address and get its coordinates and address.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: What to look up. URL-encode it.

parameters.name: autocomplete
parameters.description: Match partial words. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Only results inside minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO country codes, such as et.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language for the text in the response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many results, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: proximity
parameters.description: Prefer results near lng,lat, or `ip`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Comma-separated categories to include.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: Your API key. It has to be in the query string.

200.description: Matching places, sorted by relevance and distance.

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO code, such as ET.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude, -90 to 90.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude, -180 to 180.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: How many results, from 1 to 5. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Comma-separated categories to include.

parameters.name: apiKey

200.description: Places at the point, sorted by distance.

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO code, such as ET.

get.description: Snap a GPS trace to the roads it was driven on. The trace goes in a JSON body on a GET request, so browsers and fetch can't call it; use a server, script or cURL.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: Your API key. It has to be in the query string.

timestamp.description: When the point was recorded, ISO 8601.

mode.description: Defaults to auto. pedestrian is also accepted.

shape_match.description: Defaults to map_snap. walk_or_snap is also accepted.

distance.description: Length of the matched route in meters.
